summary: Engineering leader with 13+ years of experience architecting, building, and scaling cloud-native platforms across startup and consulting environments. Strong technical foundation in distributed systems and AWS-based infrastructure, with a proven ability to establish engineering standards, delivery practices, and scalable architectures from early-stage to growth.

Co-founder of a logistics-tech startup, responsible for building the engineering team and platform from day one. Launched the initial product in 3 months, scaled operations to Mexico and Colombia, and supported the growth of a 400+ employee company and now serving 250+ clients.

Experienced in hiring and mentoring high-performing teams, defining technical roadmaps, and aligning engineering execution with product goals. Passionate about the startup ecosystem, serving as a trusted technical advisor to other startups in Colombia, guiding architecture, technology selection, and platform design to help them scale effectively.

Active contributor to the regional tech community, including speaking at industry events and collaborating with AWS initiatives to foster communities of technology leaders. Currently leading organization-wide AI adoption—partnering across engineering, product, operations, and business functions to embed AI into workflows, decision-making, and new product capabilities that drive efficiency and unlock revenue opportunities.
Trilingual (Spanish, English, French) with professional experience across Colombia and the United States.

experience.title: Co-Founder / VP. of SWE
bullets: Co-founded a logistics-tech startup, architecting the engineering organization and cloud-native infrastructure from inception on AWS; launched the production platform in 3 months and scaled operations across Mexico and Colombia. The company has since grown to 400+ employees across both countries and raised $25M+ across Seed, Series A, and extension rounds.
Established DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and a security-first development culture, automating more than 80 build, test, and deployment workflows.
Co-led the transition from a monolithic architecture to a domain-driven microservices ecosystem, reducing cross-team dependencies by ~80% and enabling autonomous squads to deliver in parallel.

Operated across multiple leadership roles—including Cloud Architect and Product Manager for Transportation, Monetization, and Support domains—delivering solutions that enabled new pricing and revenue capabilities adopted by 400+ clients.
Defined and implemented a standardized, repeatable technology stack and deployment model to support automation-first operations and consistent onboarding of new teams and services.
Partnered with operations and external stakeholders to translate logistics and fulfillment challenges into scalable technical solutions; led technical due diligence for 6 strategic partnerships.

Built the engineering function from the ground up, scaling the team from 0 to 25+ engineers while achieving 95% retention from inception to present; established role definitions, career ladders, and mentoring practices.
Designed and institutionalized the development lifecycle, aligning engineering execution with product management through agile practices, quarterly planning, and OKR-driven delivery.
Architected and implemented the company’s disaster recovery and reliability strategy, establishing an RTO of <1.5 hours to ensure business continuity.
Driving cultural adoption through hands-on leadership, mentoring teams on how to incorporate AI into daily development, decision-making, and automation processes.
